title: al-ʿIzzī: a first classical ṣarf
summary: Al-Zanjānī's short book of the verb's patterns and their meanings, the shared ṣarf text of the Ottoman and Arab paths.

sections.heading: The book
paragraphs: Al-Taṣrīf al-ʿIzzī sets out the bare and augmented patterns of the verb, the meanings each pattern often carries, the derived nouns and the main rules of weak letters, in a few pages.
In the Ottoman madrasa it is the fourth of the five books of ṣarf; at al-Azhar and in Arab circles it is often the first classical text of ṣarf.
